## Senior Salesforce Administrator

![Matillion](https://cdn.getro.com/companies/ab82abd3-a4c7-483a-8678-5e6852e7f69d-1761875315)

Matillion

This job is no longer accepting applications

[See open jobs at Matillion.](https://jobs.sapphireventures.com/companies/matillion#content) [See open jobs similar to "Senior Salesforce Administrator" Sapphire Ventures.](https://jobs.sapphireventures.com/jobs?q=Senior%20Salesforce%20Administrator)

Software Engineering, Sales & Business Development

USD 84k-126k / year + Equity

Posted6+ months ago

Matillion is The Data Productivity Cloud.

We are on a mission to power the data productivity of our customers and the world, by helping teams get data business ready, faster. Our technology allows customers to load, transform, sync and orchestrate their data.

We are looking for passionate, high-integrity individuals to help us scale up our growing business. Together, we can make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves.

We're now looking for a **Senior Salesforce Administrator** to join #teamgreen.

As a Salesforce Administrator, you'll play a key role in implementing and optimizing Salesforce functionality and related tooling to help Matillion grow and scale.

### What we are looking for

- **Project Execution and Support:** Support various projects and initiatives to customize and configure Salesforce to meet our needs. You'll translate business requirements into technical solutions, and push the approved configurations to production.
- **System Configuration and Maintenance:** Implement new scalable solutions using Salesforce objects, fields, formulas, flows, and more.
- **Test and Validate:** Ensure all configurations are thoroughly tested before going live.
- **User Support:** Provide day-to-day support troubleshooting issues and maintaining system security, including user provisioning, roles, and permissions.
- **Stay ahead:** Stay up-to-date with Salesforce's latest releases and features, ensuring our tools evolve and scale.

### What we are looking for

- Minimum of 4 years of Salesforce Experience, preferably in a configuration or administrative role.
- Salesforce Administrator Certification; Advanced Administrator is a plus.
- Proficiency in Salesforce Configurations (objects, fields, flows, validation rules)
- Familiarity with tools like Outreach, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.
- Detail orientated, with exceptional analytical and problem solving skills.

At Matillion, we are committed to providing competitive compensation in line with market standards based on the role, job family, job level, and country. This exempt role’s estimated annual salaried pay range for this position is $84,000 - $126,000, and the final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.

This job posting will be closed to applications on February 5th, 2025. Please submit your application in advance of this time. We’ll be responding to applications as quickly as possible, post the closing date.

Matillion has fostered a culture that is collaborative, fast-paced, ambitious, and transparent, and an environment where people genuinely care about their colleagues and communities.

Our 6 [core values](https://www.matillion.com/about/) guide how we work together and with our customers and partners. We operate a truly flexible and hybrid working culture that promotes work-life balance, and are proud to be able to offer the following benefits:

\- Company Equity

\- 25 days PTO

\- 5 days paid volunteering leave

\- Health insurance

\- Life insurance

\- 401K

\- Access to mental health support

**More about Matillion**

Thousands of enterprises including Cisco, DocuSign, Slack, and TUI trust Matillion technology to load, transform, sync, and orchestrate their data for a wide range of use cases from insights and operational analytics, to data science, machine learning, and AI.

With over $300M raised from top Silicon Valley investors, we are on a mission to power the data productivity of our customers and the world.

We are passionate about doing things in a smart, considerate way. We’re honoured to be named a great place to work for several years running by multiple industry research firms.

We are dual headquartered in Manchester, UK and Denver, Colorado.

We are keen to hear from prospective employees, so please apply and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch. Alternatively, if you are interested in Matillion but don't see a suitable role, please email talent@matillion.com

_Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type, Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law._
